# Synthetic fixtures

These MusicXML files are synthetic test data created for this project. They do
not contain copied musical works and may be redistributed with the repository.

- `simple.musicxml`: monophonic notes, rest, accidental, direction, signatures.
- `polyphonic.musicxml`: multiple voices, chord, lyrics, ties, slur, tuplet,
  dynamics, tempo, repeat, and volta.
- `rich_notation.musicxml`: multiple staves, explicit staff assignments,
  lyric extensions, overlapping slurs, technical fallback notation, complex
  directions, and repeat/ending attributes.

The local 73-measure real-world score was used for private regression testing
but is intentionally not included because its redistribution status is unknown.
